verdict.rationale: Stripe documents programmatic API surfaces across Agentic Commerce. These include the v2 Product Catalog Import API with permission-scoped restricted keys, List CheckoutSessions for bulk fulfillment, SPT creation with usage_limits and revocation, the Refunds API, and state-transition webhooks. A hosted MCP server exposes the Stripe API to agents, and a live runtime probe confirmed it responds behind OAuth. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths, key ACS endpoints gated behind private preview or waitlist, community reports that the MPP docs are sparse on end-to-end object semantics, no independent hands-on API usage reports.
